parked.spanish: Y se apareció ángel de Jehová a él en llama de fuego de medio de la zarza, y vio, y he aquí la zarza ardiente en el fuego, y la zarza no consumida.

findings.issue: Construct מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה is definite by the proper name; Spanish drops the article before ángel (el ángel de Jehová), grammatical smoothing without changing the referent.
מִתּוֹךְ is from-the-midst; de medio de under-renders the interior/midst preposition versus de en medio de, without adding a new concept.
Active participle בֹּעֵר rendered as adjective ardiente rather than a verbal participle (ardiendo / que ardía); meaning unchanged.

parked.spanish: Y vio Jehová que se desvió para ver, y llamó a él Dios de en medio de la zarza, y dijo: Moisés, Moisés. Y dijo: Heme aquí.

findings.issue: archaic presentative; not current Spanish for «aquí estoy»

readerNotes.note: archaic presentative; not current Spanish for «aquí estoy»
Added 'ustedes' as the explicit subject so the verb reads as address to you (plural), not as a report about 'they', per the cited 2mp form; no participant or meaning was changed.
Chose 'lo que' over 'el que' because the bare relative אֲשֶׁר carries no gender; 'el que' would wrongly supply a masculine antecedent.
'Vacíos' is kept as a predicate adjective agreeing with the implied plural subject (ustedes), rendering the adverb רֵיקָם as grammatical smoothing without changing its sense.
